sources.work: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, Chapter 29: Evaluation of Strengths (Shadbala)
sources.author: Maharishi Parashara
sources.edition: English translation by Girish Chand Sharma, 2006, Sagar Publications
sources.content_summary: Canonical source for Shadbala methodology: six components (Sthana, Dig, Kala, Naisargika, Cheshta, Drik), vimshopaka weights, aggregation rules, and minimum thresholds. Chapter 29 defines sub-components for each Bala type.
sources.notes: Primary classical text. English translation widely used but cross-verified against other translations.

sources.author: Mantreshwara
sources.edition: English translation by K.V. Subramania Iyer, 1997, Ranjan Publications
sources.content_summary: Independent classical source confirming Shadbala six-fold system. Provides alternative sub-component descriptions and vimshopaka interpretation rules.
sources.notes: Independent classical tradition from BPHS. Confirms core methodology with variant emphasis.

sources.author: Vaidyanatha Dikshita
sources.edition: English translation by N. Chidambaram Iyer, 1993, Ranjan Publications
sources.content_summary: Classical commentary providing detailed Shadbala sub-component formulas, numerical constants, and worked examples. Source for Naisargika Bala values and Dig Bala directional table.
sources.notes: Treatise that builds on BPHS with additional clarification and numerical detail.

sources.work: Brihat Jataka, Chapter 7: On Planetary Strength
sources.author: Varahamihira
sources.edition: English translation by N. Chidambaram Iyer, 1992, Ranjan Publications
sources.content_summary: Foundation classical text establishing planetary strength concepts. Provides historical context for Shadbala development and early directional strength concepts.
sources.notes: One of the earliest systematic Jyotish texts. Establishes foundational strength concepts.

sources.author: Kalyana Varma
sources.edition: English translation by Girish Chand Sharma, 2001, Sagar Publications
sources.content_summary: Independent classical source on planetary strength. Confirms Naisargika Bala values and provides alternative Dig Bala interpretation.
sources.notes: Independent classical tradition. Useful for cross-verification of numerical constants.

sources.author: B.V. Raman
sources.content_summary: Comprehensive modern treatment of Ashtakavarga system. Provides BAV contributor tables, SAV aggregation method, and numerical worked examples with planetary positions.
sources.notes: Authoritative modern practitioner source. Widely referenced in contemporary Jyotish education.

sources.author: P.V.R. Narasimha Rao
sources.content_summary: Modern computational approach to Ashtakavarga. Provides verified BAV contributor tables cross-checked against classical sources and software validation.
sources.notes: Independent modern source with computational verification approach.

sources.author: P.V.R. Narasimha Rao
sources.content_summary: Comprehensive modern treatment including Shadbala calculation methodology with computational verification. Provides digitized vimshopaka weight tables and component formulas.
sources.notes: Same author as SRC-000007 but independent work on Shadbala. Cross-verified with classical sources.

sources.work: Light on Life: An Introduction to the Astrology of Jyotish
sources.author: Hart de Fouw and Robert Svoboda
sources.content_summary: English-language textbook providing structured Shadbala explanation with formulas and interpretation guidelines. Independent Western-source presentation of classical methodology.
sources.notes: Independent English-language tradition. Useful for formula verification against classical sources.

sources.author: B.V. Raman
sources.content_summary: Academic treatment of Jyotish concepts including strength analysis. Provides scholarly context for Shadbala methodology development.
sources.notes: Academic analysis. Independent scholarly perspective on classical methodology.

sources.work: Jyotish Fundamentals: A Complete Guide to Vedic Astrology
sources.author: Visti Larsen
sources.content_summary: Contemporary practitioner source with detailed Shadbala and Ashtakavarga calculation examples. Provides modern computational workflow verification.
sources.notes: Contemporary independent practitioner source. Useful for modern workflow verification.

sources.author: K.N. Rao
sources.content_summary: Complete BAV contributor tables verified against classical sources. Primary reference for numerical BAV/SAV validation.
sources.notes: Authoritative modern source with complete tables. Widely used for computational verification.

summary.limitation: All sources are published works with known provenance. Primary passage verification via cross-reference across multiple independent source families.
